component.name: bonita
component.title: Bonita
component.description: Start cases of processes in a remote Bonita engine through its REST API.
component.label: workflow

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

useGlobalSslContextParameters.label: security
useGlobalSslContextParameters.description: Enable usage of global SSL context parameters, for the endpoints with the https protocol that have no sslContextParameters of their own.

CamelBonitaCaseId.label: producer
CamelBonitaCaseId.description: The id of the case that the startCase operation started.

producerIn.description: The contract inputs of the process: a Map of the input names and their Serializable values, a FileInput for a file to upload, or a JSON object as text that is parsed into that Map with Jackson. Any other body, also JSON text that is not an object, fails with an InvalidPayloadException

producerOut.description: The body as sent: a Map of the inputs has each FileInput replaced by a Map of its filename and the tempPath of the upload. The id of the case started is in the CamelBonitaCaseId header

operation.description: The operation to perform. Only startCase is supported: it starts a case (an instance) of the process that the processName option names, with the contract inputs from the message body.

hostname.description: The host name of the Bonita server. The producer calls the REST API under the /bonita context path of this host.

port.description: The HTTP port of the Bonita server.

processName.description: The name of the process to start a case of. The producer searches the processes of the Bonita REST API for this name and uses the first one found, and fails if none is found or the option is not set.

protocol.description: The protocol of the REST API of the Bonita server: http, or https to send the login, the session cookies and the requests over TLS. With https, set the port to the HTTPS port of the server, and the sslContextParameters option when the JVM does not trust the certificate of the server.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

password.label: security
password.description: The password of the Bonita account. The producer logs in with it at the loginservice of Bonita before each request, and fails if it is not set.

sslContextParameters.label: security
sslContextParameters.description: The SSL configuration of the HTTPS connections to the Bonita server, such as the trust store with the certificate of the server. It is used only when the protocol is https; without it the default SSL context of the JVM is used.

username.label: security
username.description: The username of the Bonita account. The producer logs in with it at the loginservice of Bonita before each request, and fails if it is not set.
